novelty_flags.label: prop:homogeneous-boundary
novelty_flags.one_line: Its asserted zero-remainder homogeneous-effect reduction is already stated by Leung2022ANI; retain it only as a sanity corollary, not a novel proposition.

soundness_flags.label: ass:ani-coupling
soundness_flags.one_line: Leung's ANI condition is an L1 vanishing-tail condition, whereas this assumption imposes a geometric L^{2+delta} rate; retag and justify it as a stronger proposal condition or weaken the claimed regime.

soundness_flags.label: ass:score-stabilization

accepted_scope_caveats.label: thm:hac-exactness, thm:uniform-hac-exactness, and thm:uniform-wald
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: GRAC is accepted as a new, independently stated graph-law condition rather than a consequence of the older stabilization primitives.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Exactness and coverage are field-tier conditional claims only for laws satisfying a fully formalized GRAC condition; the OEQ remains the separate question of whether older primitives imply GRAC.

Theorem 4.2 requires network exogeneity; Remark 4.3 says it ensures disconnected agents are uncorrelated. The proposal accurately identifies this as the closest exogenous-network comparator.
